audience: coaches with an offer who confuse reach with buyer intent
promise: Four million views can produce zero revenue when the content attracts viewers instead of buyers.

evidence.claim: The content received four million views.
The same outcome produced zero dollars in attributed revenue.
The creator delivers the opening on camera.

frameZero.visual: The creator holds the 4M VIEWS and $0 receipts toward the lens.

beats.speech: This Reel got four million views and made me zero dollars.
beats.visual: Both verified receipts fill the foreground with the creator between them.
beats.change: The contradiction is visible before the sentence finishes.

beats.speech: The views were real. The buyers weren't.
beats.visual: The view receipt stays bright while the revenue receipt is circled red.
beats.change: The evidence is annotated to identify the business failure.

beats.speech: I optimized distribution and ignored buyer density.
beats.visual: The receipts fold into a two-variable model: distribution multiplied by buyer density.
beats.change: The contradiction advances into the mechanism.

frameZero.visual: The analytics and revenue records appear as two equally sized evidence cards.

beats.speech: Four million views on this side. Zero dollars on this one.
beats.visual: Two verified records land side by side with no winner treatment.

beats.speech: So the viral Reel worked—and the content strategy failed.
beats.visual: A brace connects both records to the label WRONG AUDIENCE.
beats.change: The apparent win is reframed as a strategic loss.

beats.speech: Here is the filter I should have used before posting.
beats.visual: A three-question buyer filter replaces the brace without removing the receipts.
beats.change: The evidence advances into an actionable filter.

frameZero.visual: A wall of view notifications surrounds the creator while one empty checkout tray sits untouched.

beats.speech: This is what four million views felt like.
beats.visual: The notification wall creates overwhelming apparent success.
beats.change: Volume establishes the expectation of business success.

beats.speech: Then I checked how much money it made.
beats.visual: The wall freezes and the empty $0 tray pushes through the center.
beats.change: One physical contradiction breaks the repeated pattern.

beats.speech: I built reach and forgot purchase intent.
beats.visual: Notifications sort into VIEWERS while the empty tray becomes BUYERS.
beats.change: The metaphor resolves into the mechanism.

risks: The notification wall must be derived from the real receipt rather than invented metrics.

captionMuteWindows.reason: The evidence objects carry their own text.
